fields.label: Allowance
fields.description: Pick an existing pay line or type a new name: a new one is created as a Salary Component when you save.

fields.label: Type
fields.description: Used when the allowance is new. For an existing one it follows its Salary Component.

fields.label: Default Rate
fields.description: Used for every employee tagged with this allowance whose own rate is blank. Per day / meal / hour for an attendance-based allowance, per month for Fixed Monthly, a percentage for % of Initial Basic.

fields.label: Attendance Based
fields.description: Counted from each month's attendance and posted by Prepare Payroll Inputs on the Payroll Entry.

fields.label: Calculation
fields.options:
Fixed Monthly
% of Initial Basic
From Salary Structure
fields.description: Fixed Monthly and % of Initial Basic are added to the salary slip from the employee's Allowances table. From Salary Structure: the structure already computes it; this record only supplies the accounts.

fields.label: Based On
fields.options:
Status = Present
Status = Half Day
Worked on Holiday
Meal Entitlement
Authorised Overtime
Late Time
Early Entry Before
Late Stay After
Late Arrival After
fields.description: Status = Present: days present (tea). Meal Entitlement: meals earned by extra time or holiday hours. Authorised Overtime: hours on a submitted Overtime Sheet. Late Time: late + early-exit time (fine).

fields.label: Only OT-Eligible Staff
fields.description: Pay only employees with OT Eligible ticked (policy 2.2: OT-eligible staff get overtime and meals).

fields.label: Unit
fields.options:
Per Day
Per Hour
Flat per Period

fields.label: A Half Day Counts As
fields.options:
Full Day
Half Day
Not At All

fields.label: Time Offset (Hours)
fields.depends_on: eval:doc.is_attendance_based && ["Early Entry Before","Late Stay After","Late Arrival After","Meal Entitlement"].includes(doc.based_on)
fields.description: Meal: arriving this many hours early, or leaving this many hours late, earns one meal each.

fields.label: Rate Basis
fields.options:
Fixed Rate
Hourly Basic × Multiplier
Daily Wage
fields.description: Fixed Rate: the rate below/on the employee. Hourly Basic × Multiplier: overtime and late fine, priced off each person's basic. Daily Wage: the assignment base of a daily-wage structure.

fields.label: Accounts
fields.description: Which account each section's cost posts to. The section is set on the employee's Department. A blank Marketing or Plant account falls back to the Admin & Accounts one.
